resources.purpose: public filings, revenue, diluted shares, period metadata
controls: identify the client with a User-Agent
configure KIC_SEC_CONTACT with a real team contact before fetching
respect SEC fair-access and rate limits
follow SEC Privacy and Security Policy
store retrieval timestamp and source URL

resources.purpose: demo-only historical close snapshot for the public rehearsal
controls: do not describe as a production market-data license
do not automate for KIC operations without permission or an approved license
replace with an approved vendor or exchange feed before deployment

resources.purpose: optional planner and explanation layer after security approval
controls: set KIC_LLM_POLICY=approved
set KIC_LLM_ALLOWED_MODELS explicitly
allowlist provider and model
use an approved private gateway
do not send internal KIC material outside the approved boundary

resources.purpose: optional enterprise or private LLM endpoint after security approval
controls: set KIC_LLM_POLICY=approved
set KIC_LLM_ALLOWED_MODELS
allowlist provider and model
use KIC_LLM_PROVIDER for an approved private gateway
inject API key through secret store only
keep internal material inside approved boundary
retain access and deletion policy
